h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gangtok

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gangtok

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Gangtok

c: Flat ground is scarce in Gangtok, and that shapes every outdoor gym we plan for the city. Most sites are terraces cut into the hillside, a narrow strip beside a road, or a small courtyard in a school or government complex. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, government campuses, housing complexes and public spaces in Gangtok. It is made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,830 km away.

The machines travel by road to Sikkim, and the last stretch is through hill roads, so we plan the dispatch with that in mind. Our installation team or a dealer in the northeast grouts each base into a level pad. Send us photos of your terrace with rough measurements. We will send a layout drawing that fits the machines to the space you have and marks the clear area around each one.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can outdoor gym machines be installed on a hillside terrace?
items.a: Yes, on a level, grouted pad for each machine. Keep a clear zone around every station and do not place machines at an open edge without a railing.

items.q: Which machines suit a small space in Gangtok?
items.a: Combination machines such as the Leg Press Cum Fun Walker Cum Seating Twister, multi-user twisters and a pull up station. They offer several exercises without needing much flat ground.

items.q: How does the equipment reach Gangtok?
items.a: By road from our Vasai factory, including the hill roads into Sikkim. Our installation team or a dealer in the northeast then installs it as per the approved layout.
